description: Create a source index for jurisdiction price models before extracting values.
completion_policy: Complete-with-gaps means the repository now has a machine-readable jurisdiction source-index API with public-safe metadata or explicit blocked rows for every state and territory. It does not claim extracted official state or territory price values, redistribution rights for restricted schedules, or validated local-unit-to-HWAU mappings.

implemented: public-safe metadata or blocked rows for NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, ACT, and NT
source rows that do not redistribute jurisdiction price values
not_implemented: official extracted state and territory price values
redistribution of restricted state or local funding schedules
validated mapping from QWAU, WIES, WAU, or local activity terms to HWAU

gap_register.description: Public-safe or blocked source-index rows exist for every state and territory, but the rows intentionally do not extract numeric price values.
gap_register.rationale: The source-index API closes the missing-row blocker while preserving fail-closed behavior for official price extraction.

gap_register.description: Official state and territory price values remain unextracted until each source licence, unit definition, and mapping rule is validated.
gap_register.rationale: The track indexes sources before extraction; it must not claim public support for restricted or unvalidated price schedules.

remaining_external_gates: official source review and value extraction for jurisdiction-specific price schedules
licence review for restricted or unclear state and local schedules
validated unit mappings for QWAU, WIES, WAU, and local activity terms
